import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_csv('/mnt/uploads/sales.csv')
df['revenue_per_order'] = df['revenue'] / df['orders']
grouped = df.groupby(['month', 'region'], as_index=False)['revenue_per_order'].mean()
months = sorted(grouped['month'].unique())

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5))
for region, data in grouped.groupby('region'):
    data = data.sort_values('month')
    ax.plot(data['month'], data['revenue_per_order'], marker='o', label=region)
ax.set_xlabel('Month')
ax.set_ylabel('Revenue per order')
ax.set_title('Revenue per Order by Month and Region')
ax.set_ylim(bottom=0)
ax.legend(title='Region')
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
fig.tight_layout()
